ns2:section.sectionText: Promotes leadership and social/civic engagement through experience in the research or management of the Covid-19 pandemic. The course serves to advance students' understanding of COVID-19 from multiple expert perspectives, as well as to connect undergraduates with faculty and/or community organizations working on aspects of the pandemic within a citizen scholars model. The course requires participation in the campus Covid Speaker Series, engagement with a specific Covid-19 related research or management-mitigation project, and reflections on what is being learned. Students may or may not already have a relevant work/service project arranged with a faculty member or campus/community organization prior to the start of the course. For those who do not yet have a project set up, this course will assist you with finding one for the term of enrollment in the course.
